title: Mochizuki Honami — Aftermath Of Courage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, which one's her seat again...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry, Kiritani...
Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Mochizuki...
Hoshino and Tenma just went out into the corridor...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I was actually hoping to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So... I've been meaning to thank you for the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The other day...?
Oh, when we talked about our solo shows?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Compared to joint shows, you have to think much more carefully about solo shows and do considerably more work, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's pretty easy to become overwhelmed by all the things you need to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, the people who come to see you only have one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They just want to see an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really appreciate the advice you gave me then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you hadn't said that, I'd probably still be lost and not know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really glad that I got to hear from you about your own solo show, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really.
I just relayed whatever information I could.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it wasn't nothing. You helped so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At the time... We were overwhelmed with everything that we had to do and I really didn't know what we could do about it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, your story reminded me that we have to stay true to our main goal... To play music that moves people's hearts and to make sure that they enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, to make sure we have fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because of what you said, I was able to muster up the courage to speak openly to the representative of a record company.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was able to tell him how we truly feel and why we're a band at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I honestly just told you how I felt regarding solo shows...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However... It's really nice to hear that I was able to help you somehow, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Actually...
Mind if I reserve some tickets for your solo show?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? But you're already so busy as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am, but this conversation made me want to go see you and your band play for myself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I'll keep that day open by any means necessary.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Kiritani...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One for me... Three for Minori and the others, assuming they agree to come along... So, we'd be reserving four in total.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We promise to bring you a really moving performance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, Mochizuki, good luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
I really appreciate it, Kiritani!
